name: Dragon, Ruby
body:
RUBY DRAGON
CR 3

This chubby dragonet’s scales glitter like red gems; its coppery claws look as sharp as knives and apt to burrow through the hardest rock.

XP 800
NG Tiny dragon (earth, fire)
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, tremorsense 60 ft.; Perception +9

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 13, flat-footed 14 (+1 Dex, +2 natural, +2 size)
hp 30 (4d12+4)
Fort +7, Ref +5, Will +6
Immune fire, paralysis, sleep
Weaknesses vulnerability to cold

OFFENSE

Speed 10 ft., fly 30 ft. (average), burrow 40 ft.
Melee bite +6 (1d3), 2 claws +6 (1d3)
Space 2-½ ft.; Reach 0 ft.

Special Attacks adamantine attacks, breath weapon (5 ft. cone, 2d6 fire damage, Ref DC 13 for half, usable every 1d4 rounds)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 4th; concentration+6)

3/day–earth glide

Spells Known (caster level 4th; concentration +6)

2nd (4/day)–flaming sphere (DC 14)
1st (7/day)-blend with surroundings, expeditious excavation, lava droplets (DC 13)
0th (at will)–flare (DC 12), grasp, light, mending, prestidigitation, spark

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 13, Con 12, Int 10, Wis 14, Cha 15
Base Atk +4; CMB +3; CMD 13
Feats Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative
Skills Climb +8, Fly +12, Knowledge (nature) +6, Perception +9, Stealth +8, Survival +9
Languages Draconic

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Adamantine Attacks

A ruby dragon’s natural weapons are made of adamantine, and have the qualities of weapons made from that material.

Spellcasting

A ruby dragon casts spells as a 4th-level sorcerer.

ECOLOGY

Environment volcanoes or arid badlands
Organization solitary or family (1-6)
Treasure standard

Ruby dragons live inside and around active volcanoes, lay eggs on solidified lava blocks in lava lakes inside craters, and hoard the little gems and stones brought to surface by eruptions.

A NG arcane spellcaster of at least 7th level with the Improved Familiar feat may select a ruby dragon as a familiar.
